featured_reviews.name: Kusal Rai
featured_reviews.review_text: Tucked away in an aesthetic corner of South Bombay, this bookstore is a true haven for book lovers. With its charming atmosphere and thoughtfully curated shelves, it offers an impressive range of genres that caters to every kind of reader. Whether you’re hunting for a classic, exploring contemporary fiction, or diving into niche subjects, this place makes browsing feel like an experience rather than just a visit. A must-stop spot for any book nerd wandering through the city.

featured_reviews.name: Anil Bishnoi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ashish Book Centre, tucked away near the bustling CSMT Railway Station in Fort, is nothing short of a paradise for true book lovers. In a city that’s always racing against time, this bookstore feels like a quiet, timeless refuge where stories patiently wait to be discovered.

What makes Ashish Book Centre truly special is its incredible collection. From rare second-hand classics and academic textbooks to novels, competitive exam guides, and out-of-print treasures—you never know what gem you’ll stumble upon. Browsing through the shelves feels like going on a literary treasure hunt, and every visit brings a new surprise.

The owners and staff are extremely knowledgeable and helpful. They don’t just sell books; they understand them. Whether you walk in with a specific title in mind or just a vague idea of what you want to read, they guide you with genuine enthusiasm and honesty. Their passion for books is infectious.

Another big win is the affordability. Ashish Book Centre proves that great reading doesn’t have to be expensive. Students, avid readers, and collectors alike will appreciate the fair pricing and excellent condition of the books.

Located in the heart of Fort, just a stone’s throw from CSMT, it’s incredibly convenient and perfectly placed for a spontaneous visit after work or college. Despite the chaos outside, the store offers a calm, almost nostalgic vibe that reminds you why physical bookstores still matter.

If you love books, value knowledge, or simply enjoy the charm of old-school bookstores, Ashish Book Centre is an absolute must-visit. It’s not just a shop—it’s an experience, a legacy, and a reminder that the love for reading is very much alive in Mumbai. 📚

featured_reviews.name: Hemang Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Eons ago I had no money to buy expensive CS books so I used to go visit the store. Stand inside and read books. Thought myself a lot and whatever I achieved in CS was partly thanks to Sterling Book store.
I must have read 8-10 text books cover to cover in various CS related subjects and it was helpful. Obviously I never bought a book but I am eternally greatful to the staff in allowing me to educate myself.

featured_reviews.name: karthik venkatesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was searching for a good CX-3 flight computer calculator, and many of my friends recommended Stirling Bookhouse. Based on their suggestion, I placed an order for the CX-3 on the 25th of September, and to my surprise, it got delivered by the 27th of September.

The delivery was super fast and smooth, without any hassle. The CX-3 calculator I received was brand new, perfectly packed, and working flawlessly. I’m really impressed with the quality and the professionalism in their service.

I am very happy with my experience and would definitely recommend Stirling Bookhouse to anyone looking for aviation supplies or books. Their service is reliable, and they truly live up to the recommendations I got from my friends.

featured_reviews.name: Anant
featured_reviews.review_text: I perfect model with A321 Neo 1:400 of Indigo beautiful made and fantastic.  Sterling has been a old friend team of all Captains since ages of India itself. They were very with quick support always. Wonderful with their Team and the Models as well.

featured_reviews.name: ARQAM
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely poor and student-unfriendly experience. I bought ACCA books worth ₹12,000 and returned to the store within just 4 days with the books completely unused and in perfect condition. Despite this, the staff flatly refused any return, exchange, or store credit.

The shop shows zero concern for students spending large amounts on professional courses. They rely entirely on a rigid “no return” line instead of basic customer fairness. No support and no empathy.

I strongly warn that : double-check everything before buying, because once they take your money, they take no responsibility.

featured_reviews.name: Bishal Mandal
featured_reviews.review_text: I had ordered 'The Aviator's Handbook, 5th Edition' by Cdr. Thomas Tom from Sterling Book House via SpeedPost and had received my shipment on-time. First of all, I got 10% discount and free shipping offer from Sterling Book House. Making payment online was also very easy, fast, secure and hassle-free. Secondly, I got my Invoice & shipment tracking information all in my email. At the same time, they provided real time support to me over WhatsApp regarding shipment status. And thirdly, when I received my parcel safely then it was very well packed with brown cardboard and plastic sheet. The book was also in very good condition. My whole experience with Sterling Book House was really excellent and fulfilling. Based on my experience with Sterling Book House, I will definitely order more and more aviation books from them in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Sujal Solia
featured_reviews.review_text: They sell dirty & damaged books and don't exchange it for another, dont buy from here order online

featured_reviews.name: Manjiri
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a CX-3 flight computer from Sterling Book House in Mumbai, and I’m beyond impressed with their service. The delivery was incredibly quick—I received my order the very next day! On top of that, the price was significantly lower compared to Amazon and other online stores, which was a big plus.

The product arrived in perfect condition, well-packaged, and exactly as described. It’s clear that they value their customers and ensure a smooth shopping experience.

If you’re looking for aviation supplies or books, I highly recommend Sterling Book House. Their combination of quick delivery, competitive pricing, and excellent service makes them stand out.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience
with this bookshop owner. I purchased a book that was claimed to be the 5th edition, but upon closer inspection, it turned out to be a reprint. When I brought this issue to his attention, he initially refused to exchange it. After some back and forth, he finally agreed to an exchange but insisted that I travel all over Nerul to his chosen location.

As a doctor with a busy schedule, I simply do not have the time to run errands for one book. I even suggested dropping the book off at a nearby store, JJ Store, to make the process easier for both of us, but he outright refused. This lack of flexibility and understanding is unacceptable, especially when the mistake was on his part.

I would not recommend this shop to anyone who values their time or expects decent customer service. A little consideration and professionalism would go a long way!

I am based outside of India and needed books for my son in a short time, so  I interacted with the store and they supported me by shipping me just one book to decide and then rest of the books through express delivery. This helped us save a lot of time duing a short trip to India.

featured_reviews.review_text: Very humble and understanding team... Had lovely purchase experience... Thank u team

featured_reviews.review_text: Have always got excellent service from the staff. We are 3 generation using their books for year's together.

featured_reviews.name: Aarti Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good and honest. I wanted to return some books after 15 days, and they accepted the books back with full refund, on the spot. This is very rare. I would definitely recommend this book store for all your needs
